checks.name: Clipboard image extraction and text-preserving paste
checks.observation: Tests verify image-only paste, unchanged ordinary text paste, mixed image+plain-text insertion at the active textarea selection, fallback filenames for anonymous clipboard blobs, non-image filtering, and wiring into the TEXT and DM scoped upload pickers. Paste does not submit a message. Shared-limit tests cover exactly ten accepted files, rejects the eleventh, and enforce the common 25 MB per-file maximum before upload.

checks.name: Attachment-only TEXT and DM send contract
checks.observation: Both stores send body:empty only when attachment IDs exist and keep empty text-only drafts unsent. The private DM mutation client accepts an empty response body only when the response contains at least one attachment.

checks.name: Full frontend suite and production build
checks.observation: 213 test files and 627 tests passed; vue-tsc and Vite production build passed. Vite reports the existing LiveKit chunk-size warning.

checks.name: Flutter attachment-only send parity
checks.observation: All 123 Flutter tests passed, including empty-body TEXT/DM with an attachment and rejection without attachments; analyzer reported no issues.

checks.name: Authenticated browser/device clipboard acceptance
checks.reason: No authenticated browser/OS clipboard fixture was available. Real clipboard permissions, actual image paste in TEXT/DM, channel/DM switching during upload, and 507/retry need a browser session. Native Flutter image clipboard support is not yet implemented and is tracked as FE-56.

privacy: The browser reads only image/* ClipboardEvent items. Image bytes enter the existing conversation-scoped upload path and never enter the message body; any co-pasted text is inserted as plain text at the caret. No send is automatic, and existing size/count checks remain in force.
remaining: Run authenticated browser paste/retry/507/DM-participant checks and implement FE-56 for native image clipboard on Android, macOS and Windows.
